title: Rotary tuner
description: A detented olive dial tunes a recessed LCD inside a molded radio enclosure.
useCase: Station, preset, or channel selection in a compact player.
interaction: Rotate the rim, drag from the center, or use arrow keys
reducedMotion: The knob settles immediately under reduced motion.
limitations: Local station presets; no network radio or audio stream.
look: Light warm-grey page with a cream plastic radio: dotted speaker grille, pale green LCD readout in monospace digits, and a knurled dark-green knob.
motion: Dragging the knob rotates its pointer within ±120° (rim drags follow angle, centre drags follow horizontal movement); release snaps to the nearest of five 60° detents over 200 ms ease-out.
adapt: Rotation lives in `onPointerMove` (`2.4` degrees per horizontal pixel, or angular from the rim) and `finish`, which snaps to `-120 + station * 60`; the settle is the 200 ms transition on `.sf-tuner-knob i`. Replace `stations` with your presets.
